punchline: New Coke won the taste tests and lasted 79 days on the market.
thirty_sec: In 1985 Coca-Cola launched a sweeter New Coke that beat the old formula and Pepsi in taste tests. After launch it got more than 40,000 calls and letters, its hotline took over 1,500 calls a day, and fans of the old drink filed a class action. The old formula returned 79 days later as Classic. Summaries of the Yes! chapter on loss use it to show that what people may lose weighs more than what they may gain.
